capabilities: Selectively sync items to Apple Reminders and Calendar
Query sync status without resubmitting uncertain jobs
extras: Requires macOS 14+ on Apple silicon and a separately installed helper; the helper is ad-hoc signed and not Apple-notarized. No cross-process or crash exactly-once guarantee is made, and community approval remains unverified.
problem: Day Planner schedules are confined to Obsidian, with no built-in way to preview and push selected items into Apple Reminders and Calendar.
summary: Obsidian plugin that previews Day Planner schedules and selectively syncs them to Apple Reminders and Calendar on macOS.
